{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Soldier's Broadsword Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Soldier's Broadsword Model.png|320x320px]] |Model AoI= [[File:AoI Soldier's Broadsword Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Soldier's Broadsword Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Soldier's Broadsword Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite AoI= [[File:AoI Soldier's Broadsword Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Fighting [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 14 |durability= 25 |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Soldier's Broadswords''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Soldier's Broadsword|Soldier's Broadswords|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoCDE, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoCDE}}{{Name Ref|AoCDE}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 14 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Soldier's Broadsword}} Soldier's Broadswords are [[Weapon]]s that [[Link]] can use to defeat [[Enemy|Enemies]], destroy [[Barrel]]s and [[Jar]]s, and cut down [[Tree]]s. Soldier's Broadswords will usually deal 14, but that increases to 28 damage when they are thrown and broken. They were once brandished by those who once defended [[Hyrule Castle]] prior to the [[Great Calamity]]. They are considered a good and durable Weapon to use against [[Monster]]s. Link can find them commonly in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]]. A Soldier's Broadsword can be found planted in the ground of the cave located behind the [[Waterfall]] that feeds the [[River of the Dead]]. Scanning the following [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Soldier's Broadsword: * {{SSB}} Series [[Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Toon Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ}} Series [[Link]] ({{TLoZ}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series Toon Link ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{TP}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{SS}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series Link (Rider) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Urbosa]] amiibo Soldier's Broadswords are made of metal, and they will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. This also means that they will conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, Soldier's Broadswords will not burn near [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]]. Soldier's Broadswords belong to the [[Soldier's Gear]] equipment archetype, which were all utilized by the [[Hylian Knight]]s prior to the [[Great Calamity]]. A Soldier's Broadsword is part of an unnamed set of equipment used by Link in promotional media, alongside a [[Traveler's Bow]] and a [[Traveler's Shield]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_002" |Life = 23 |Power = 14 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 18 |BuyingPrice = 70 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Soldier's Broadsword}} {{Stub|TotK}} Soldier's Broadswords return as [[Weapon]]s. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} A Soldier's Broadsword is [[Link]]'s default [[Weapon]]. It is broken during the [[Movie]] "[[The Master Sword Emerges]]". In {{AoCDE}}, the ancient version of the Soldier's Broadsword is an in-game bonus [[Weapon]] for [[Link]] if viable save data for {{AoI}} is found on the [[Nintendo Switch 2]] console. When it is equipped, it is paired with the same ancient [[Shield]] that [[Typhan]] uses. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Soldier's Broadsword appears as a [[One-Handed Weapon]].
